qualitative_hypothesis.causal_change: Replace every inter-call policy-bearing handoff with one sealed analysis-only edge and grant the terminal call exclusive first-and-final policy authorship without raw external-input visibility.
qualitative_hypothesis.expected_effect: Removing executable inheritance should permit joint formation of contract conformance and behavioral stance, coherently changing scan-resistance response, phase-shift adaptation, and the object-hit versus byte-hit tradeoff.
qualitative_hypothesis.falsifier: all-valid matched majority and strict-median contract, with no score
qualitative_hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: The active family commits to an executable artifact before causal obligations are fully reconciled, constraining terminal authority to inherited boundaries and localized semantic revision.

structural_mutation.after: The upstream call emits only a sealed causal analysis; the terminal call sees only that analysis, inherits no executable artifact, and alone instantiates the complete policy.
structural_mutation.before: An upstream call creates a complete executable closure with immutable contract authority, and the terminal call revises behavior-bearing semantics inside that inherited artifact.
structural_mutation.factor: terminal-exclusive policy genesis across a policy-free sealed-analysis edge
structural_mutation.why_structural: The sole handoff changes artifact class, write authority, evidence visibility, and policy-creation timing rather than renaming or dividing existing roles.
